# Lyric Video

The film: a 16:9 player on desktop and a 9:16 vertical video on phones, with each sung line arriving, sweeping and leaving on the beat. Links one Song Version per language and carries the credits, photos and fonts.

Part of [Lyric Player](../LyricVideo/just-ask-for-it), the Choreo-animated K-pop lyric video by @ctse.
